A blank screen left behind

start: Android 13 or older phone with the Health Connect app, MettleUp's permission screen

Nothing happens

start: Phone with no browser installed (or the browser disabled)

steps.action: Tap the privacy policy link on Health Connect's screen
user_sees: Health Connect's screen stays as it was
must_not: A crash of MettleUp
A see-through screen that blocks taps

MettleUp opening its own home screen

start: Member reads the policy from Health Connect's link

must_not: A different policy from the one in the Play Console
A page that does not mention Health Connect
